name: ONLYOFFICE Docs
description: Online editors for documents, spreadsheets and presentations (connects to Nextcloud).
compose:
services:
  onlyoffice:
    image: onlyoffice/documentserver:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8088:80"
    environment:
      - JWT_SECRET=${SECRET}
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/www/onlyoffice/Data
      - ./logs:/var/log/onlyoffice
